items.content_html:
The most recent Zoom updates yield a Zoom package that fails to function. In a nutshell:

  • The zoom program is resistant to patchelf even in the old version. Some trickery with the dynamic elf loader wrapping zoom was required to make it work.
  • The new version's ZoomLauncher program is now also "unpatchable" and requires the same trickery.
  • The new version's ZoomWebviewHost program is now also "unpatchable", but I failed to fix it even with wrapping with the elf loader, LD_LIBRARY_PATH, and argv0 modifications. Note/Reference: There has been trouble with ZoomWebviewHost in the past, but those lessons didn't help me here.

Maybe there is a way to get Zoom working with patchelf/ld.so/LD_LIBRARY_PATH and similar wrappings, but I ultimatelly failed to discover it. To me, it seems newer Zoom versions insist quite strongly on an FHS-compatible environment.

So the pull request at hand does that: It wraps zoom with buildFHSEnv. With that change, Zoom works without any additional wrappers or (library) path modifications, so most of the patching code used previously disappears. Besides:

  • Zoom is updated to the current release (by cherry-picking commits from #393649 ).
  • Support for xdg-desktop-portal is added, fixing #359533 . This wasn't possible without the FHS environment. However, that might improve with an upcoming Zoom release (provided that release is usable at all).
  • The Exec= entry in the .desktop file is turned into a relative path
  • Some missing Qt5 libraries are added (discovered with autoPatchelfHook).
  • Some QT5_* environment variables apparently no longer need to be unset.
  • Tiny improvements to the test derivation's code.

Notifying maintainers: @danbst @tadfisher
Notifying @philiptaron per #381281 (review) (thanks again!)

Reference to Zoom meta issue: #107495

I'm setting this as draft for now as I'm not sure whether we should wait for the next release.

nix-shell -p nixpkgs-review --run "nixpkgs-review rev HEAD" wants to rebuild 4k packages and was therefore skipped.

More: I prepared the following testing environment:

  • x86-64
  • built the package as is, i.e., without cherry-picking/rebasing the commit(s) somewhere else
  • placed the resulting package into systemPackages of
    • an existing and up-to-date NixOS 24.11 installation with X11/Plasma5/Pulseaudio
    • an existing and up-to-date NixOS unstable installation with X11/Xfce/Pulseaudio (inside a VirtualBox)
  • Login in X11/Plasma5 with PulseAudio

Tested the following functions successfully:

  • sidebar loads (albeit empty on my installation, cf. #344931 )
  • audio is "detected" by zoom: microphone VU-meter shows amplitude (not tested in VirtualBox)
  • audio is produced: "Test speaker" generates audible ting-a-ling (not tested in VirtualBox)
  • other participant's audio in video conference is audible (not tested in VirtualBox)
  • other participants can hear me (not tested in VirtualBox)
  • sending camera picture in video conference works
  • participant's camera video is received in video conference
  • screen sharing sends screen to other participants
  • participant's shared screen is displayed
  • "Participants" dialog box is shown (cf. #116355 )
  • reading team chat messages works as expected
  • SSO works: Zoom starts Firefox, then Firefox calls back to Zoom after login, as usual

I did not test the following functions/mechanisms/bindings, but it would probably be good to have them tested:

  • writing team chat messages
  • the sidebar being non-empty
  • xdg-desktop-portal (cf. #359533 )
  • Pipewire
  • Wayland
  • Darwin

items.content_html:
Many flutter apps indirectly depend on xdg-user-dir being in PATH by using path_provider which in turn uses xdg_directories: https://github.com/flutter/packages/blob/a87eddf0c281d5d017093125c1a8d9161257741f/packages/xdg_directories/lib/xdg_directories.dart#L188

For example running Ente Auth Appimage from ente.io:

[ERROR:flutter/runtime/dart_vm_initializer.cc(41)] Unhandled Exception: MissingPlatformDirectoryException(Unable to get application documents directory)
#0 getApplicationDocumentsDirectory (package:path_provider/path_provider.dart:123)

items.content_html:
Ref: NixOS/nix#5588

This searches in $XDG_DATA_HOME/nix/profile everywhere where
previously we only looked in ~/.nix-profile, ditto for
.nix-channels and .nix-defexpr. This shouldn't break any
compatibility for now. It is highly recommended to use nixpkgs with
these changes if you want to use Nix with the XDG basedir PR, but not
doing so shouldn't result in any dramatic breakage -- in fact, NixOS
is perfectly usable without any user profile.
